use_case: Connect Claude or ChatGPT via MCP to scan watchlists, check live quotes, or model strategies in plain English.
eligibility: New subscriptions. Current trial users can apply the discount from the app banner. One discount per subscription.
renewal_terms: Renews at the standard price after the first year on annual or after the first 3 payments on monthly.
notes: Annual first year (USD): Visualizer 50 (normally 100), Pro 150 (normally 300), All Access 250 (normally 500). Monthly for the first 3 payments (USD): Visualizer 5 (normally 10), Pro 15 (normally 30), All Access 25 (normally 50). The AI connection needs All Access or the 7-day trial.
